user.title: Bastion
user.description: Security audit, configuration versioning in git and anomaly detection. Everything is configured in the options after setup.

audit.title: Security audit
audit.description: GitHub token stored: {token_state}. Leave the token field empty to keep it.

data.github_token: GitHub token (optional, read only, higher API limit)

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Targets are notify entities (notify.xyz) or notify services (notify.mobile_app_phone). A persistent notification is always created.

data.notify_min_severity: Notify for new findings from severity
data.notify_logins: Notify on logins and new IPs
data.notify_public_ip_only: Only for logins from public IPs
data.brute_force_threshold: Brute force alarm after failed logins (10 min)
data.geoip_lookup: Look up country of public IPs (sends the IP to ipwho.is)
data.notify_actions: Buttons 'That was me' / 'Block' in the Companion App

git.title: Git versioning
git.description: Private GitHub repository for the configuration. SSH: a deploy key is generated in the next step. HTTPS: fine-grained token with contents read/write for this repository only. Secrets are always encrypted with the passphrase; keep it in your password manager. Token stored: {token_state}, passphrase stored: {passphrase_state}. Leave secret fields empty to keep them.

data.git_url: Repository URL (SSH like git@github.com:user/repo.git, or HTTPS)
data.git_passphrase: Encryption passphrase for secrets (required, min. 12 characters)
data.git_allow_unverified_private: I confirm the repository is private (if it cannot be checked)

git_key.title: Add deploy key
git_key.description:
Add this public key to {url} as a deploy key **with write access** (GitHub: Settings → Deploy keys → Add deploy key):

```
{public_key}
```

The private key never leaves Home Assistant. Continue when the key is added.

git_test.title: Connection works

git_test_failed.title: Connection failed

probe.title: External check
probe.description: URL of your Bastion Cloudflare Worker (see extras/cloudflare-worker). It probes only the public IP of this Home Assistant. Token stored: {token_state}.

data.anomaly_entities: Sensors to learn (power, water, gas, temperature …)

canary.title: Decoys
canary.description: Bastion creates a decoy token (user 'api-backup', read-only, local only) and a decoy webhook. Any use is rejected immediately and raises an alarm. Token and URL are shown in the panel under Anomalies; plant them where an intruder would look (notes, NAS share).

data.canary_in_git: Place decoy as .env in the git repository (detects repository leaks)

error.ssh_needs_key: SSH URLs need SSH key authentication.
error.https_needs_token: HTTPS URLs need a token (or 'none' for local tests).
error.insecure_http: Plain HTTP is not allowed, use HTTPS.
error.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Is the deploy key added with write access / the token valid?
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the git server.
error.host_key_mismatch: The server key does not match the stored or published key.
error.invalid_key: The stored SSH key is invalid. Generate a new one.
error.repo_public: The repository is public. Bastion only pushes to private repositories.
error.repo_unverified: Bastion could not verify that the repository is private. Confirm it in the settings.
error.https_required: The worker URL must use HTTPS.
error.passphrase_required: A passphrase is required: secrets are always backed up encrypted.
error.passphrase_too_short: The passphrase must have at least 12 characters.

external_scan.name: External check
external_scan.description: Checks which ports of the public IP are reachable from the internet.

git_commit.name: Back up configuration
git_commit.description: Commits and pushes the configuration now.

git_restore.name: Restore configuration
git_restore.description: Restores files from a commit. The current state is committed first.

paths.name: Paths
paths.description: Only these repository paths, e.g. homeassistant/automations.yaml.

dismiss_finding.name: Dismiss finding
dismiss_finding.description: Hides a finding or shows it again.

accept_integrity.name: Accept integrity baseline
accept_integrity.description: Accepts the current files of custom_components and www as known good.

domain.name: Integration
domain.description: Only this integration, 'www' or empty for all.

reset_git_host_key.name: Reset git server key
reset_git_host_key.description: Forgets the stored SSH host key after you verified a legitimate change.

send_report.name: Send weekly report
send_report.description: Builds the weekly report and sends it now.

block.name: Block
block.description: Revokes a token, bans an IP and/or deactivates a user.
